title: Customer Service & Sales Advisor
description:
Customer Service & Sales Advisor
- Location: Bradford, BD3
- Salary: 24,735 basic + uncapped bonus
- Hours: Mon-Thurs 9am-5:30pm Fri 10am-4pm
- Contract: Full-time, permanent
- Holidays: 25 days + bank holidays + option to buy/sell 5 days + additional leave for international holidays
- Hybrid working - following completion of probation period

Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences and looking for a role that combines service with sales?

Join a fast-growing Bradford-based business as a Customer Service & Sales Advisor, where your enthusiasm and people skills will be rewarded with great pay, supportive training, and real career development.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Responding to inbound calls and warm leads from customers who've requested a call via the website (dealing with the renewal process for an insurance policy)
- Taking a consultative approach to understand customer needs and guide them to the right solution
- Handling queries professionally and efficiently, ensuring every interaction is a positive one
- Putting the customer at the heart of everything you do, delivering a first-class experience

What We're Looking For:

title: Customer Service and Sales Representative
description:
Customer Service & Sales Representative - Build to Rent

Leeds £27,000-£29, hours per week

Cobalt is recruiting a Customer Service & Sales Representative for an established Build to Rent operator in Leeds.

This is an on-site role combining customer service, lettings and property operations within a large residential development. You will support residents throughout their journey, from their first enquiry and viewing through to moving in and day-to-day life within the development.

The development also offers communal facilities including a co-working lounge, gym, gardens, movie room and car park.

The organisation

Our client is an established Build to Rent operator with a focus on creating a residential experience where people feel listened to and looked after.

Customer service and community are central to the development, with the on-site team supporting residents while maintaining a high-quality living environment.

The Customer Service & Sales Representative will work alongside colleagues across leasing, facilities, operations and finance, reporting directly to the General Manager.

The role offers:
- A salary of £27,000-£29,000.
- 40 hours per week across five days.
- Shifts between 08:00 and 19:00 on a rota basis.
- Saturday working on a rota basis.

The role and responsibilities

As the Customer Service & Sales Representative, you will have a varied position covering the resident journey, lettings administration and the day-to-day operation of the development.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Responding to enquiries from current and prospective residents by telephone, in writing and face to face.
- Conducting property viewings and following up with prospective residents.
- Supporting resident applications, tenancy contracts and renewals.
- Assisting with check-ins, check-outs, inventories and the wider move-in and move-out process.
- Maintaining accurate information across CRM and property management systems.
- Supporting deposit administration, rent collection, utility registrations and council tax communications.
- Providing a welcoming reception experience for residents, prospective residents, contractors and visitors.
- Helping to resolve resident queries, service requests and complaints.
- Supporting resident events and activities that contribute to the community within the development.
- Assisting with property inspections, maintenance reporting and the overall presentation of the building.
- Working with the General Manager and wider team to identify improvements to customer service and lettings processes.

The Customer Service & Sales Representative will therefore suit someone who enjoys working directly with people and wants exposure to customer service, lettings and property operations within Build to Rent.

The skills needed

We are looking for someone who can provide a high standard of customer service while managing the administrative requirements of a residential environment.

You should have:
- Experience within property lettings or a related residential environment, such as Build to Rent, student accommodation or serviced apartments.
- Good customer relationship skills and attention to detail.
- Good organisation and administration skills.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and confidence using property management systems.
- The ability to work independently while supporting colleagues across the development.
- The flexibility to work Saturdays and public holidays in line with the rota.

Experience within the private residential or Build to Rent sector would be advantageous. Knowledge of Yardi or a similar property management system, sales experience and ARLA membership would also be beneficial, but are not listed as essential within the job description.

This is an opportunity to become a Customer Service & Sales Representative within an established Build to Rent environment and contribute across the complete resident journey.

Apply now, as interviews are ongoing and the position may be filled once a suitable candidate is identified.

Due to the volume of applications received, if you don't hear back from us, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

If you require any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process for any reason whatsoever, please let your Cobalt consultant know.

title: Internal Sales / New Business Executive
description:
Internal Sales / New Business Executive

Location: Bradford, West Yorkshire

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 basic + Bonus + Benefits

Streamline Search is working with an established and highly regarded large-format print and visual communications business that is looking to appoint an ambitious Internal Sales / New Business Executive.

Our client has built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality print and visual communication solutions to a broad range of commercial customers across the UK.

The business offers an end-to-end service, supporting customers from initial concept and technical consultation through to production, finishing and installation.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially driven sales professional who enjoys prospecting, opening doors and developing new customer relationships.

The role will initially be predominantly office-based, focused on generating and qualifying new business opportunities through proactive outbound activity.

There is genuine scope for the successful candidate to develop into a more senior Business Development position over time, taking greater ownership of customer meetings, account development and the full sales cycle.

Package
- £30,000 - £35,000 basic salary
- Uncapped / performance-related bonus structure
- Permanent position
- Monday to Friday office-based role
- Opportunity to join an established and respected business
- Excellent product and production capabilities
- Strong market reputation
- Genuine progression into a Business Development role
- Support from experienced senior commercial staff on meetings and larger opportunities

The Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities through proactive outbound sales activity.

This is a genuine new-business role and would suit someone who enjoys picking up the phone, speaking with decision-makers, qualifying opportunities and building a strong pipeline.

Initially, the focus will be on prospecting, lead generation and developing relationships from first contact. For larger opportunities, you will work closely with senior commercial colleagues who can support with client meetings, technical discussions, proposals and closing.

As you develop your knowledge and customer base, there will be scope to take greater ownership of the complete sales cycle and progress into a Business Development Manager position.

Key Responsibilities
- Making proactive outbound calls to prospective customers
- Identifying and targeting businesses with potential large-format print and visual communication requirements
- Building relationships with key decision-makers
- Generating and qualifying new business opportunities
- Developing opportunities through telephone, email and LinkedIn outreach
- Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective customers
- Booking customer meetings for yourself and senior commercial colleagues
- Following up quotations, proposals and live opportunities
- Working closely with senior management to progress and close larger opportunities
- Approaching marketing teams, agencies, retailers, contractors, event businesses and other relevant organisations
- Understanding customer requirements and introducing suitable solutions
- Keeping CRM and pipeline information accurate and up to date
- Re-engaging previous customers and dormant accounts
- Identifying opportunities across new sectors and markets
- Converting prospects into profitable, long-term customers
- Achieving agreed activity, new-business and revenue targets

The Candidate

We are looking for an ambitious, confident and commercially driven sales professional who genuinely enjoys new-business development.

You do not necessarily need to have worked within large-format print previously, although experience within print, manufacturing, signage, packaging, marketing services or another B2 B environment would be advantageous.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous B2 B sales, internal sales, telesales or business development experience
- A genuine appetite for winning new business
- Confidence making outbound calls and approaching new organisations
- Strong communication skills and a natural ability to build rapport
- A proactive and resilient approach to sales
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to discuss customer requirements
- Strong follow-up and organisational skills
- A target-driven mindset
- The ability to work independently while also taking guidance from senior colleagues
- A desire to develop into a more senior Business Development position

This role could suit an experienced Internal Sales Executive, New Business Executive, Sales Executive, Business Development Executive or an ambitious Account Manager looking to move into a more proactive new-business position.

Streamline Search is a technical recruitment agency based in Chichester, West Sussex, operating across the United Kingdom. We are acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this vacancy and, in accordance with GDPR, by applying to this post you are granting us consent to process your data and contact you in relation to this application.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Location: Huddersfield, West Yorkshire (Office-Based)
Salary: 35,000 Basic + Bonus
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm

An Exciting Opportunity in a Specialist Industry

Are you a confident, commercially minded sales professional who enjoys building relationships, delivering excellent customer service and turning enquiries into sales?

This company is looking for an enthusiastic Internal Sales Executive to join its team in Huddersfield.

Specialising in the supply of industrial door and loading bay parts to the trade, this company supports engineers, installers and service companies with the components they need to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in internal sales, technical parts or B2 B customer service to join a specialist business where product knowledge, customer relationships and a proactive sales approach are key to success.

Experience within the industrial door industry would be a real advantage, but we're equally interested in candidates from other technical sales or parts backgrounds.

The Role

As an Internal Sales Executive, you'll be a key point of contact for trade customers, helping them source the right products while maximising sales opportunities and delivering an outstanding level of service.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Handling incoming sales enquiries via telephone and email from engineers, installers and trade customers.
- Proactively following up quotations, developing customer relationships and converting enquiries into orders.
- Identifying the correct industrial door and loading bay components, offering suitable alternatives where appropriate.
- Preparing accurate, competitive quotations and processing customer orders.
- Working closely with purchasing, warehouse and logistics teams to ensure orders are fulfilled efficiently.
- Providing customers with product availability, pricing and delivery information.
- Identifying opportunities to increase sales from existing customers and develop repeat business.
- Resolving customer queries and maintaining accurate records using internal CRM and order management systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and confident speaking with customers, with the commercial awareness to spot opportunities and turn conversations into sales.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in internal sales, B2 B sales, trade counter sales or a technical parts environment.
- Excellent telephone communication skills and a confident, customer-focused approach.
- A proactive sales mentality with the ability to follow up opportunities and close orders.
- Strong attention to detail when dealing with product specifications, quotations and part numbers.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple enquiries in a busy environment.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office, CRM systems or order processing software.

Industry knowledge would be particularly desirable, especially experience with products such as:
- Industrial roller shutters and sectional overhead doors.
- High-speed and fast-action doors.
- Dock levellers and loading bay equipment.
- Door motors, control panels and automation components.
- Safety edges, seals, sensors and associated spare parts.

However, candidates with experience selling engineering components, electrical parts, mechanical spares or other technical products are also encouraged to apply.

What's On Offer?
- 35,000 basic salary plus bonus.
- Monday to Friday working hours - no weekends.
- Permanent, office-based position in Huddersfield.
- Specialist product training and ongoing support.
- Opportunity to develop your technical knowledge and sales expertise.
- A varied role combining customer service, relationship management and commercial sales.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Internal Sales Executive, Parts Advisor or technically minded sales professional looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Please note, if your application is suitable, one of our consultants will call you within 5 working days. If you have not heard from us within this time, your application has unfortunately been unsuccessful, however we will keep your details on our talent management system to consider you for future opportunities.

title: Outbound Sales Executive
description:
Advertising Sales (Outbound) Executive

Snowflake Media Ltd Halifax, West Yorkshire

Hours: Full-Time or Part-Time
Full-Time: Monday to Friday, 9.00am 5.00pm
Part-Time: 18 hours per week, flexible within Monday to Friday, 9.00am 5.00pm
Salary: £30,000 basic + bonus OTE £40,000 (full-time equivalent, pro rata for part-time)

About Us

Snowflake Media Ltd is an established and growing community publishing business with over 20 years' experience connecting local people with trusted businesses, services and organisations.

We produce a network of successful local community magazines and guides, helping businesses promote their services directly to households within the areas they serve.

Our publications cover everything from local tradespeople, including electricians, plumbers and builders, through to professional services, charities, councils and community organisations.

We currently publish 10 magazines, including the well-known Grapevine magazines across Halifax, as well as titles covering Knaresborough and Wetherby. We are also expanding into specialist publications, including childcare and senior care directories.

Following the continued success and growth of our publications, we have created a dedicated Advertising Sales Centre in Halifax and are now looking for experienced outbound sales professionals to join our team.

The Role

This is a telephone-based advertising sales role working from our modern Advertising Sales Centre in central Halifax.

You'll spend much of your day speaking with local businesses, building rapport, understanding their needs and introducing advertising opportunities across our range of publications.

Previous outbound sales experience is essential. Ideally, you will have at least 2 years' experience in telephone advertising sales, telesales, outbound B2 B sales or a similar cold-calling environment, with evidence of achieving sales results or targets.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Making proactive outbound calls to local businesses
- Introducing our publications and advertising opportunities in a friendly and professional way
- Building relationships with new and existing business customers
- Understanding customer needs and recommending suitable advertising options
- Following up with businesses who have received information about our publications
- Working towards agreed sales targets and performance objectives
- Accurately logging calls, conversations and outcomes within our CRM system
- Scheduling and completing follow-up calls
- Developing a pipeline of prospective advertisers and converting opportunities into sales

Our approach is professional, friendly and conversational rather than scripted or overly aggressive. However, this is a proactive outbound sales position, so you must be confident picking up the phone, cold calling businesses and asking for the sale.

Working Environment

You'll be joining a supportive team where individual contribution is valued and success is shared.

We use a CRM system to manage our customer relationships and sales pipeline, giving you clear visibility of:
- Businesses already contacted
- Prospective customers and sales opportunities
- Information requests
- Previous conversations and notes
- Scheduled follow-up calls
- Progress through the sales process

You'll have the tools and information you need to manage your pipeline effectively while working alongside a team focused on growing our publications and advertiser base.

Pay & Rewards
- £30,000 basic salary based on a full-time 37.5-hour week
- Salary pro rata for part-time employees
- OTE approximately £40,000 for the full-time role
- Performance-related bonus linked to advertising sales
- Established publications and customer base
- Supportive team environment
- Opportunity to join a growing publishing business

Working Hours

We currently have two opportunities available:

Full-Time
Monday to Friday, 9.00am 5.00pm.

Part-Time
18 hours per week, worked within our Monday to Friday, 9.00am 5.00pm opening hours.

We can offer some flexibility around how the 18 part-time hours are worked for the right candidate, and there may also be opportunities to increase hours in the future.

Both positions are office based in Halifax.

Outbound sales requires resilience. There will be times when you make several calls before speaking to the right person, so you'll need to be positive, persistent and comfortable working in a target-driven sales environment.

Next Steps

If you're an experienced outbound sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing new business and turning conversations into sales, we'd like to hear from you.

Please apply with your CV, clearly showing your previous outbound sales, cold-calling or advertising sales experience and your track record of success.

Please note: previous successful outbound sales/cold-calling experience is essential for this role.

Equals One is an advertising and recruitment agency working on behalf of our client to promote this vacancy. You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful.

description:
